item.title: Major UN report highlights overpopulation and overconsumption, need for profound transformation
item.description: The report is very candid regarding the fundamental drivers of our planetary crises — population growth, overconsumption, and growth-dependent.

item.title: The Science of Longevity: Latest Discoveries and Breakthroughs
item.description: Longevity research has made remarkable strides in recent years, with scientists uncovering new ways to slow aging and improve healthspan.

item.title: What is Superintelligence?
item.description: In the view of some AI scientists, once AI becomes a mature Superintelligence, achieving Singularity, humans may be under its control.

item.title: More on God and Ethics
item.description: But what is sin? As I learned in Sunday School long ago, sin is the transgression of the will of God by thought or deed.

item.title: Experts Warn of ‘Disastrous’ Climate Impacts If Trump Seizes Control of Greenland
item.description: Regional warming is opening up potential shipping routes and access to natural resources, from minerals to oil.

item.title: The dogma of papal infallibility
item.description: Papal infallibility means that the pope is incapable of error when he makes ex cathedra decisions on matters of faith and morals.

item.title: The Thread and the Turning: How American Evangelicalism Reached Its Breaking Point
item.description: The central contradiction is stark: a movement that claims to follow a gospel of mercy has aligned itself with cruelty, exclusion, and political idolatry.
